$comment: Label vocabulary /port:init creates in a managed repository.
Each entry names the module that owns it, mirroring port.config.json's modules keys
plus the `core` sentinel for a label that is always created. No module currently gates
a label — every entry below is `core` — but the field stays as a designed extension
point for a future optional label, not dead weight.
`key` is the port.config.json `labels` key. `name` is the default string, which a
repository may override there. Agents read the configured name, never these defaults
directly.
`role` is one of marker / trigger / in-flight / gate / terminal, copied from
pipeline/SKILL.md's own 'Role' column. It is the machine-readable authority the
rendered workflows' blocking-label list is derived from, pinned in both directions —
not merely documentation.
`palette` is the pipeline phase a label belongs to — plan, implement, review, revise,
refresh, needs-you or done — or null for a marker. One palette is one hue, shared by
the label here, the desktop app's Board pill and its sidebar dot. Within a palette a
trigger is a lighter shade than its in-flight label, and a gate or terminal label sits
deeper still, so position within the phase reads from lightness alone.
The in-flight label of each palette is its anchor: its colour is exactly the app's
light-theme dot for that palette (`theme.css`), so GitHub and the app share one hex.
needs-you gates sit two steps apart (DC2626 -> 991B1B) so they still separate by
lightness under red-green colour vision deficiency.
`claude` and `auto plan` are markers: neutral, off the palette, because they mark
ownership rather than a phase. `claude` keeps Claude coral (`D97757`).
`previousColors` lists every colour port has shipped for the key before the current
one, so /port:init can tell a label port coloured from one the repository coloured
itself, and recolour only the former.

labels.name: claude
labels.description: The port pipeline owns this item

labels.name: auto plan
labels.description: Plan gate skipped: the plan is auto-approved

labels.name: plan changes requested
labels.description: Trigger: revise the plan from human feedback

labels.name: refresh branch
labels.description: Trigger: rebase and force-push, no code changes

labels.name: planning
labels.description: In flight: a plan is being researched

labels.name: plan review
labels.description: Gate: plan written, awaiting human approval

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Gate: needs a human decision, details in a comment

labels.name: needs human
labels.description: Gate: the pipeline stopped and needs a person

labels.name: pr opened
labels.description: Terminal on the issue: state now lives on the pull request

labels.name: approved
labels.description: Terminal: findings are at or under the bar, a human merges
